backtest_protocol.execution_model: TLT, QQQ, SPY, and candidate stock features are computed from OHLCV rows with Date <= signal_date. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: TLT rate-relief plus liquid growth leadership may identify high-duration stock continuation candidates when falling-rate tape supports re-rating, expanding the default-off candidate pool without using SEC/LLM fields.
interpretation: The TLT rate-relief growth leadership source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). Do not promote or tune this fixed cross-asset macro proxy bundle on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT rate/duration evidence (for example issuer-level rate sensitivity, financing-duration exposure, or closed forward replacement-value rows), not a sweep of TLT lookbacks, TLT thresholds, QQQ/SPY thresholds, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping TLT/IEF lookbacks, rate-relief thresholds, QQQ-vs-SPY threshold, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Need issuer-level rate-sensitivity/financing-duration data, borrow/options confirmation, or closed forward replacement-value rows before revisiting rate-relief growth leadership.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.1440; aggregate PnL delta $+1,736.14; max drawdown drift +0.0156; 56 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected. TLT rate-relief plus liquid growth leadership did not add robust replacement value versus the accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration checks (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The relation likely relabels crowded growth momentum rather than a distinct duration edge.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: TLT rate-relief plus liquid growth leadership may identify high-duration stock continuation candidates when falling-rate tape supports re-rating, expanding the default-off candidate pool without using SEC/LLM fields.

2_history_check.exp-20260607-019: Accepted volatility-relief stock leadership used VIXY volatility compression. This run uses TLT duration/rate relief, not VIXY.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-002: Rejected oil-cost relief travel leadership. This run is not a commodity cost-relief sector proxy.
2_history_check.exp-20260618-006: Rejected intra-industry lead-lag direction stability. This run is cross-asset macro context plus single-stock leadership, not industry diffusion.
2_history_check.exp-20260619-015: Rejected regime-conditioned intra-industry lead-lag. This run does not re-slice that relation source or regime bucket.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: Novelty gate warned on generic OHLCV continuation families. The override declares a new evidence axis: cross-asset duration proxy from PIT TLT OHLCV with canonical-window broad-warehouse coverage.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior relation alpha worked only when the relation itself supplied replacement value; TLT/rate relief has not been tested as a fixed candidate source in the recent frozen list, but broad ETF proxies often fail after costs, so confidence is low.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing TLT/QQQ/SPY OHLCV, failed rate-relief context, missing candidate OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $75M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same TLT rate-relief context, QQQ-vs-SPY growth-tape context, liquid SPY/QQQ-relative leadership gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
